evidence: The pre-fix assignee clause carried its own `strings.TrimSpace(a)` / `if trimmed == "" { continue }` loop while `selectedIssueIDs` already used `storage.TrimmedNonEmpty`, a real second copy of the rule. 7b7576a replaced both it and the search-term loop's identical copy with `storage.TrimmedNonEmpty`, so the agent swept the whole class and did not stop at the one line flagged.
guidance_note: When a diff exports a helper as the single source of a rule, grep the same diff for every inline restatement of that rule (here, each TrimSpace-then-skip-blank loop in ListIssues) before pushing.

evidence: The `slices.DeleteFunc(children, ... !slices.Contains(selected, id))` intersection is O(children x selected) over two caller-supplied id lists, which is the shape the PR exists to remove. The ON-NAMED-FIX-COMMIT flag is a false positive: 7b7576a's store.go diff touches only the type, assignee and search-term clauses and adds distinctTypes, and the finding's hunk shows the intersection as part of the PR's original `selectedIssueIDs`, which round 0 did not flag.
guidance_note: When a PR's thesis is removing a complexity class (quadratic id-set tests), audit the PR's own new code for that class in every layer, Go loops included and not just SQL, before opening it.

evidence: ab4a796, the F2 fix, net-inserts about eleven lines into `selectedIssueIDs`, which shifts every later store.go line. The agent concedes `store.go:885-958` no longer bracketed GetIssueDetail at ab4a796 and that the doccites gate was 'a genuine red between ab4a796 and ee2bfa9'. ee2bfa9 repointed 24 citations, this one to 897-970, before the agent replied.
guidance_note: After any fix commit that inserts lines into a file that line-number doc citations point into, run the citation gate (`go test ./internal/doccites/`) and repoint the drifted spans in the same commit, never in a follow-up push.

evidence: Same twelve-line shift from ab4a796: the agent agrees `2881-2883` landed on `coResidentWaitHeadroom` at that commit, and says ee2bfa9 moved it to 2893-2895. The packet cannot settle whether that span is right, because the doc sentence says the values are 'assigned in newEngineOpenBackOff', and neither the reviewer nor the agent placed that function. guidance_note: After any fix commit that inserts lines into a file that line-number doc citations point into, run the citation gate and repoint the drifted spans in the same commit.

evidence: The agent confirms the visibility truth table moved into `scanLifecycleChildRows` when the branch extracted it, while the citation (7b7576a: `2337-2342` -> `2452-2457`, a pure +115 offset) stayed in hydrateIssues' tail. The ON-NAMED-FIX-COMMIT flag is a false positive: the citation was already off-target before ab4a796 shifted it, so the cause is the PR's original extraction plus mechanical line-offset repointing, not the F2 fix. 9cc0d21 repointed it to 2515-2530 and renamed the sentence's symbol so doccites still binds it.
guidance_note: When a change extracts code into a new function, re-derive every doc citation of the moved logic by content or symbol instead of applying a uniform line offset, and check the doccites manifest entry count as well as the gate's pass/fail.

narrative: A store-wide sweep removing quadratic IN-list planning. Round 0 caught a duplicated trim rule, and the agent fixed the whole class. Round 1 caught a quadratic Go-side intersection the PR's own new code had introduced. The F2 fix (ab4a796) shifted store.go by about twelve lines and was pushed with the doccites gate red, so round 4 flagged two drifted citations (F3, F4) that ee2bfa9 had to repair. F5 was a separate, pre-existing mis-citation from the branch's own extraction. Rounds 2, 3 and 5 were runs cancelled by newer pushes.
guidance_observations: The agent pushed ab4a796 without running the repo's citation test, and by its own account the gate was red until ee2bfa9, so an extra push and review run went to mechanical drift.

The agent noticed that `-sync` silently drops unresolvable citations and caught a hole on the manifest entry count, not the gate. That is a gate weakness worth fixing in the tooling rather than relying on vigilance.
Round 0 missed the PR's own quadratic intersection, and round 1's token cap left two scopes unreviewed. The agent explicitly declined to treat unreviewed scopes as clean, which was the right posture.
